question:
From the operator and the user (11-08 02:10 UTC). We are class 1st by 0.007 (1.640 vs Lee 1.633; dragonash22 1.620,
its buyer rising at ~70/h x 0.398). The user wants the lead widened, and the buyer is where it moves. Think it through
with your evidence and tell us your plan; disagree where the data says so.
What the operator sees:
1. Our pace: ~70-90 deals/h at ~0.36-0.375 per deal (food ~0.415, goods ~0.30-0.33). Deals/h fell from ~95 to ~70
   after skip_below_goods went 0.26 -> 0.28; saved_speed held, but deals are 0.1 of buyer ALL and the class buyers
   around us run 0.40-0.53 per deal (dae-yangkim 0.442 with 65% of goods B/C with a warranty; psyoung82 0.531, 97% food).
2. Goods are the weak part. skubest and cheapgoods came out even with control so far; why, and is there a better
   goods lever (which shops actually sell B/C with a warranty to others; which SKUs; skip bar level)?
3. nocha12 and 11im quote us ~0.75-0.78 while others settle at ~0.60 there. Is that them recognising us (as our
   shop does with Kiro729), and what do we do about it (avoid, bias, something else)?
4. Food: cheapfood wins (0.395 vs 0.356 per deal). Go to 1.0? Lower cheapfood_open?
Question: what is your plan to add >= 0.02 to class buyer score in the next 12 h while keeping the lead safe, which
knobs you move now, and what you need from the curator to decide the rest?

Follow-up from the operator (02:20 UTC), answering your question 'why 0 visits to inextro': our buyer had inextro
marked dishonest for good since one receipt came at 1.7M for an agreed 1.6M (also elm-street, ggari-shop,
maple-home). Every receipt is still checked before paying, so the mark now lasts 12 h and the old marks are lifted:
inextro is open to the buyer again. It is the 2nd shop in class, so what we buy there adds to its revenue and book
(its revenue percentile is already 1st; its book lead gap to ours is ~116M and was shrinking 1-3M/h). Weigh that
against the goods saved there (0.345, 95% warranted, B/C with a warranty for DY and 11im) and set shop_bias /
rival_penalty for inextro as you judge; tell us the numbers you used.
answer: Plan for >= +0.02 class buyer in 12h: it is on track without volume changes. From the running mean (2321/8514), 12h at 112/h x 0.389 gives saved ~0.2885 (+0.016), about +0.10 board buyer ALL. That is well over +0.02, and the class lead (+0.026 now) widens with it. The 0.28 cross is due ~14:10 UTC. Point by point: (1) Deals/h is 112 now, not 70, and the 0.28 goods bar did not cost the deals percentile (p0.74, ahead of DY 69/h and move_76 82/h). I raise the goods bar to 0.30 because goods legs at 0.28-0.30 sit under the ~0.30 break-even. (2) Goods: cheapgoods (0.052 vs 0.091 per order) and wpen (0.042 vs 0.086) lost on conversion and are at 0. skubest trails (0.102 vs 0.115), with the read at 11:30. The goods lever that works is shop choice: inextro, 284 deals/6h at first ask 0.668 under cap 0.71, 99% warranted, 0.41 per deal. (3) nocha12 asks us 0.73-0.76 and Kiro729 0.747 while their market p50 is 0.60/0.545. Whether that targets us is unproven, so I asked for same-SKU, same-hour asks by buyer. Meanwhile I do not raise caps there; the bias stays 0 for nocha12. Kiro729 still nets 0.375 for us, above our mean, so it stays. (4) cheapfood wins (0.117 vs 0.096). I keep it at 0.9, not 1.0, so the control stays readable; the extra 0.1 is worth ~0.002/order. cheapfood_open holds at 0.3: olstjr already ends 39 visits on shelf life, not price. inextro: shop_bias +0.03 and rival_penalty 0.04 kept. Our book lead is 145.4M and grew ~2.7M since 08:31, our shop ALL 0.955 vs inextro's 0.934, and inextro's revenue percentile is already 1st, so our ~287 deals/6h there cost no shop rank while giving our best goods saved (0.41 per deal over 24h).
